studies.title: Silk
studies.treatment: TEXTURE VARIANT — FINE SILKY GRAIN. Replace source grain with a much finer tightly packed irregular luminance grain, smooth tonal transitions beneath it, velvety dark petrol fields with delicate stochastic tooth and clean cream highlights. A fine analogue emulsion look, visibly finer/softer than reference without eliminating texture. Especially clear contrast on broad floor and columns; preserve original painting strokes and material wear. Almost no coarse grain clumps, no dot screens, no uniform digital static, no smoothing into clean plastic. Mean tone/hues/exposure unchanged. This is the quieter end of the grain range.

studies.title: Rough
studies.treatment: TEXTURE VARIANT — COARSE CLUMPED GRAIN. Replace source fine grain with pronounced organic analogue grain clumps, three-to-five times larger, varied irregular clusters and pockets, strongly visible in midtones/shadows and softer sparse grain in brightest cream/amber. Whole floor and blue piers have a tactile coarse granular atmosphere while retaining edges/shapes and identical underlying materials. Random image-plane grain independent of cracks/stone/enamel geometry, not pits painted on machines. Rich heavy texture but same mean tone and dark hue balance. No regular halftone dots, ordered dithering, pixel blocks, rainbow noise, dust scratches or source microfacet inflation. A substantial coarse finish change, not additional wear.

Reduce extra pitting to original Grain amounts, put independent clearly visible random grain over petrol floor, pillars, cream cylinders and coats. Keep exact scene, lighting, mean colours/exposure, five people, four trays/bowls, all architecture/equipment/HUD geometry and words unchanged.

studies.title: Shadow
studies.treatment: TEXTURE VARIANT — SHADOW-WEIGHTED GRAIN. Make irregular medium-sized grain concentrated in dark petrol floor areas, blue pillars and deep clothing shadows. Dramatically reduce visible grain in cream lit machinery and amber highlights so those feel calm, silky and precise. Midtones form a graded transition between granular shadows and cleaner light, not separate pasted texture patches. Preserve original painting/contours/material wear and source exposure/colour; grain changes density by tonal value, not light geometry. Texture is clearly perceptible across the large dark playfield but operational apertures and warm lit cream faces stay clean. No vignette, crushing shadows, new light, photographic relighting or monochrome conversion.

studies.title: Tooth
studies.treatment: TEXTURE VARIANT — TINTED BOARD TOOTH. Carry the selected opaque painting on a visibly tactile fine fibrous paper/board ground. Irregular short fibre-like grain and subtle horizontal/diagonal tooth weave through every world tone, especially petrol floor and cream faces; a matte soft tactile surface, not film emulsion speckles. Keep the winner's modeled shapes and controlled detailed painting, merely broken pigment gently catching the tooth. Paper ground is already tinted matching local hue; no white gaps, transparent watercolor wash, wet blooms, raised crackle/impasto, crosshatching, woodgrain or conspicuous coarse fabric grid. Visible medium-grain contrast with film variants across whole scene, same dark colours/exposure. Screen HUD perfectly clean and separate.

studies.title: Pigment
studies.treatment: TEXTURE VARIANT — GRAIN INTEGRATED WITH PAINT. Mix irregular fine mineral pigment grain into the selected opaque brushwork. World texture gently follows short broad brush directions on floor and curving cream cylinder highlights rather than a uniform film-noise veil. Add a modest amount of deliberately authored dry brush drag and pigment clumping, grouping source's faceted microtexture into fewer bigger painted marks, but remain MUCH closer to Grain than Round10's broad Drybrush. Keep realistic hefty modeled volume, all detailed interaction fixtures and silhouette clarity. Not watercolor granulation/blooms, thick relief/cracked plaster, dots or dither. Colour/mood/value/light positions unchanged; tactile painted grain is the main variable.

studies.title: Bloom
studies.treatment: TEXTURE VARIANT — LUMINOUS GRAIN. Preserve winner's fine irregular film grain, with slightly softer/granular amber highlight rolloff and restrained warm light halation around ONLY existing amber apertures/lamps/reflections. Small luminous fringes merge organically with grain near those sources; petrol shadows remain rich and textured. Same source exposure and dark contrast: no broad orange veil, raised black level, large bloom cloud, haze, fog, new lighting or warmer overall grading. Cream machine faces retain painted sharpness except at existing narrow warm highlights. This explores a gentler sensual analogue finish rather than stronger brightness. Distinction comes from granular light transitions and tight halos, not another scene or new lights. Actual HUD remains exact clean white-on-dark, no glow or grain.
